title: Figure 6. A Spherically Symmetric Traversable Wormhole Observed in Space (rendering)
description: Color artistic rendering of a dark sphere containing a starfield and galaxy, set against a bright, fiery yellow-orange background, depicting a spherical wormhole entrance. Caption: "Figure 6. A Spherically Symmetric Traversable Wormhole Observed in Space". It accompanies section "C. What a Wormhole Looks Like in the Real World" and Einstein field equations (3b), (3c) and (4).
